name: Pedro Ferreiro Rega
description: Biotechnology, bioinformatics and reproducible research. Exploring biological data through computational analysis.
about: I am a Biotechnology graduate with a keen interest in omics and computational algorithms applicable to biological data. My work brings together large-scale omics data analysis, visualization and quality control to connect computational results with biological insights.

With training and experience in Python, R and data visualization, I am interested in automating workflows, ensuring data reliability and contributing to scientific discoveries. I enjoy working both collaboratively and independently.

research.title: Transcriptomic analysis of Schwann cells
research.lab: Gene Regulatory Control in Disease Lab
research.institution: CiMUS · Universidade de Santiago de Compostela
research.summary: Investigating Schwann cells in diabetic neuropathy through transcriptomic analysis in R, identifying regulatory pathways and connecting findings to biological insights.
details: Executed pipelines for quality control, statistical analysis and data visualization using FastQC, R Markdown and ggplot2.
Documented analyses to ensure reproducibility and reliability across research projects.
Used CESGA high-performance computing resources with Slurm in a Unix-like environment.
Contributed results to a bachelor’s dissertation, a congress presentation and two scientific posters.
